title: File:Former Hanomag tractor factory hall Hanomagstrasse Hanover Germany.jpg
desc: Former factory hall of former Hanomag company, errected 1922/23 for the production of plows and tractors. The building is nowadays used by successor company Komatsu (Japanese) to produce construction machines. The factory hall is located at Hanomagstrasse in Linden-Sued district of Hanover, Germany.
